description:
PostPlanify brings social media management into ChatGPT.

Create, schedule, publish, and manage social media content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Google Business Profile, and Bluesky.

Manage your full social media workflow from one place, including content planning, publishing calendars, social media analytics, performance reports, social inbox conversations, comments and messages, client workspaces, team collaboration, approvals, and account management.

PostPlanify is built for social media managers, marketing teams, agencies, and businesses managing multiple brands or client accounts. Use it to plan campaigns, review performance, generate reports, manage audience engagement, organize client work, and handle day-to-day social media operations directly from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Which of my posts performed best last month?
Draft a LinkedIn + Instagram + Facebook post about our latest feature and schedule it for tomorrow at 9am EST
List all the comments + DMs I haven't replied yet in the last 7 days
